title: Binance Futures Will Launch USDC-Margined SUI Perpetual Contract With Up to 50x Leverage
text: Fellow Binancians, To expand the list of trading choices offered on Binance Futures and enhance users’ trading experience,  Binance Futures will launch the  USDC-margined SUI Perpetual Contract  at  2024-02-08 07:00 (UTC) ,   with up to 50x leverage.  More details on the USDC-margined SUI Perpetual Contract can be found in the table below:   USDⓈ-M Perpetual Contract SUIUSDC Launch Time 2024-02-08 07:00 (UTC)  Underlying Asset Sui (SUI) Settlement Asset USDC Tick Size 0.0001 Capped Funding Rate +0.7500% / -0.7500% Funding Fee Settlement Frequency Every Eight Hours Maximum Leverage 50x Trading Hours 24/7 Multi-Assets Mode Supported Please Note:  Users will be eligible to enjoy a  10% promotional trading fee discount  for  all trades on USDC-margined futures contracts until 2024-04-03 12:30 (UTC) . Refer to this  announcement  for more information. Based on market risk conditions, Binance may adjust the specifications of the aforementioned futures contract(s) from time to time, which include the funding fee, tick size, maximum leverage, initial margin, and/or maintenance margin requirements. Multi-Assets Mode  allows users to trade the aforementioned futures contract(s) across multiple margin assets, subject to the applicable haircuts. For example, when the Multi-Assets Mode is activated, users can use BTC as margin when trading the SUIUSDC Perpetual Contract.  The SUIUSDC Perpetual Contract is subject to the terms of the  Binance Terms of Use  and the  Binance Futures Service Agreement . There may be discrepancies in the translated version of this original article in English. Please reference this original version for the latest or most accurate information where any discrepancies may arise.
